name: District of Columbia

jury_list.holder: D.C. Superior Court (jury system plan, D.C. Code 11-1904).

sources.cite: D.C. Code 11-1906 (jurors must be U.S. citizens)

private_challenge.who: Any duly registered voter (D.C. Code 1-1001.07, paragraph (5)(A) of the registration-notice subsection).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: D.C. Code 1-1001.07: written objection to the Board of Elections, with any evidence that the registrant is not qualified; the Board sends notice with the evidence; the registrant has 30 days to respond or is cancelled; the chief voter registration official decides; appeal to the Board.
private_challenge.deadlines: Challenges filed from day 90 to day 45 get an expedited review. The Board does not accept challenges after the 45th day before an election.
private_challenge.evidence_standard: The voter must have 'reason to believe' the person is ineligible; the challenge must include any supporting evidence. At a Vote Center appeal, the challenger must present 'substantial evidence that is specific to the voter being challenged.'

state_windows.applies_to: Voter registration challenges under D.C. Code 1-1001.07
state_windows.effect: The Board does not accept challenges after the 45th day before an election; challenges filed from day 90 to day 45 get expedited review.

county_board.name: District of Columbia Board of Elections
county_board.note: D.C. has a single election board; it receives registration challenges.

state_election_office.name: District of Columbia Board of Elections

ag.name: Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia

gates.basis: Key fact: in D.C., U.S. citizenship is not required to vote in local elections (D.C. Code 1-1001.02(2)(B)). A non-citizen juror record is therefore not evidence of an unlawful registration. Strict gates: counts only.

notes: Important: D.C. Code 1-1001.02(2)(B) says the citizenship requirement 'shall not apply in a local election.' Non-citizen residents may lawfully register to vote in D.C. local elections. JuryRoll must not treat a D.C. juror non-citizen record as a lead, and must not suggest a challenge on that basis.
juryroll_lead_sufficient is false for this reason, even though a private challenge procedure exists.
